steps: Go to the official CampusReel student jobs page for your university (e.g. https://www.campusreel.org/student-jobs/university-of-north-carolina-at-chapel-hill/brand-ambassador) and open the Brand Ambassador posting.
Apply through the 'Apply now' link on the official posting — current student of that university required.
Complete the interview/selection process with the CampusReel team.
Once accepted, get trained on their marketing fundamentals and the mobile apps.
Create 1-5 minute authentic videos capturing your campus life, as described in the posting.
Run on-campus awareness: share pictures/videos of your student experience through their apps and networks.
Get paid per the 'Salary $25 - 35 USD' terms — confirm in writing whether that is hourly, per-assignment, or total before you start.
timing: Not published on the official posting; confirm the pay schedule with CampusReel at the offer stage.
